description: This Java class provides serialization and deserialization methods for LwM2mClient objects, converting them to and from JSON byte arrays. It handles complex nested objects, external dependencies, and reflection-based field setting.

classes.name: LwM2MClientSerDes
classes.description: Utility class for serializing and deserializing LwM2mClient objects to and from JSON byte arrays.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an LwM2mClient object into a JSON byte array, including resources, attributes, state, session, and other properties.

methods.name: serialize (private, LwM2mResource)
methods.description: Serializes an LwM2mResource object into a JSON object, handling multi-instance resources.

methods.name: parseLwM2mResource
methods.description: Parses a JSON object to create an LwM2mResource, supporting both single and multi-instance resources.

methods.name: parseValue
methods.description: Converts a JSON element into a Java object based on the resource type.

methods.name: serialize (private, ResourceModel)
methods.description: Serializes a ResourceModel object into a JSON object.

methods.name: parseResourceModel
methods.description: Parses a JSON object to create a ResourceModel.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a resource value to a JSON object based on its type, encoding as needed.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON byte array into an LwM2mClient object, reconstructing nested objects and setting private fields via reflection.
